home.subtitle: Here's what's happening across your projects
home.appsEmptyDesc: One click, fully self-hosted — databases, automation, analytics, password vaults and more, running on your own servers.

apps.title: Apps
apps.description: One-click managed services — install and run Convex, WordPress, mail, and more.
apps.emptyDescription: Spin up Convex, n8n, Ghost, and more — one click, fully self-hosted. Pick one to get started.
apps.catalogDescription: One-click managed services. Pick one to install it as an app.
apps.updateRequiredDescription: Update your Openship instance to install this app.

verifiedApp.title: Verified app
verifiedApp.description: Uses the project's official, open-source image pinned to a version, deployed through a reviewed pipeline. The full definition is public and auditable.

customApp.title: Add a custom app
customApp.description: Upload an app definition (JSON). It's added to your catalog and marked unverified.
customApp.invalidDefinition: This isn't a valid app definition — check the required fields and references.
customApp.templatesOnly: Only template apps can be added (flow apps aren't supported).
customApp.warningDescription: This deploys images you provided — not an official, reviewed app. Review the definition and only add apps you trust.

catalogDescriptions.3x-ui: Web-based Xray panel for managing proxy inbounds, clients, traffic, and subscriptions with built-in SQLite storage.
catalogDescriptions.mail: A complete self-hosted mail server — SMTP/IMAP + webmail on your own domain.
catalogDescriptions.cli-proxy-api: OpenAI-compatible API proxy for CLI model providers, with persistent authentication and generated API access credentials.
catalogDescriptions.supabase: Full self-hosted Supabase — Postgres, Auth, REST, Realtime, Storage, and Studio behind one API gateway.
catalogDescriptions.mongodb: MongoDB document database with the Mongo Express web admin UI.
catalogDescriptions.convex: Self-hosted Convex reactive backend + dashboard, with a persistent data volume.
catalogDescriptions.n8n: Workflow automation — connect apps and APIs with a visual editor.
catalogDescriptions.ghost: Modern publishing platform for blogs, newsletters, and membership sites.
catalogDescriptions.directus: Headless CMS with an instant REST + GraphQL API over your data. Create the admin on first visit.
catalogDescriptions.nocodb: Airtable-style spreadsheet UI over an SQL database. The first sign-up becomes the admin.
catalogDescriptions.metabase: Open-source business intelligence — dashboards and questions over your data.
catalogDescriptions.grafana: Dashboards and visualization for your metrics and logs. First login is admin / admin.
catalogDescriptions.gitea: Self-hosted Git with issues, pull requests, and a first-run setup wizard.
catalogDescriptions.code-server: Run VS Code in your browser, on your server. Login uses an auto-generated password.
catalogDescriptions.uptime-kuma: Self-hosted uptime monitoring with status pages and alerts.
catalogDescriptions.freshrss: Self-hosted RSS and Atom feed reader with a first-run setup wizard.
catalogDescriptions.stirling-pdf: Split, merge, convert, OCR and edit PDFs locally. Default login is admin / stirling — change it.
catalogDescriptions.it-tools: A handy collection of developer and sysadmin utilities. No login, no setup.
catalogDescriptions.excalidraw: Virtual whiteboard for sketches and diagrams. Stateless — drawings save in your browser.
catalogDescriptions.buzz: Self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents collaborate — chat, code, reviews, and workflows in one audit log.
catalogDescriptions.minio: S3-compatible object storage with a web console — point any S3 client (aws-cli, SDKs) at it.
catalogDescriptions.kafka: Apache Kafka event-streaming broker with the Kafbat Kafka UI for topics, messages, and consumer groups.
catalogDescriptions.qdrant: High-performance vector database for AI search, RAG, and embeddings, with a built-in web UI.
